Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of rosacea  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient has inflammatory lesions

AND 
 
3 - Trial and failure (of a minimum 30-day supply), contraindication or intolerance to one

pharmacy claims)
